Exceptional Stay Amidst Comfort
Our recent stay in January early 2026,at Hotel The Paramont was nothing short of spectacular. Perfectly located just off the highway, a few miles before Air port the hotel offers both convenience and serenity—ideal for travellers who want easy access without compromising on peace and privacy.
Cleanliness was impeccable across all areas, from the sparkling bathrooms to the well-maintained common spaces and rooms. You can tell the staff takes genuine pride in upkeep.
The hospitality deserves a special mention. Warm, attentive, and always ready to go the extra mile, the team made us feel like valued guests from the moment we arrived.unforgettable experience Meals served there were not only beautifully presented but also rich in local flavors. The taste of the food was consistently excellent, with a mix of authentic regional cuisine and comforting classics.
Lastly, the pricing felt well-balanced. For the quality of service, location, and amenities provided, the rates were more than fair—offering true value for money.
Highly recommended for couples, families looking for a peaceful yet well-connected retreat. We left refreshed, recharged, and already planning our return!
